Name: InnoTel AB
Description:
Innotel AB(unlisted) was a Swedish voice communications and IoT company focused on MVNO-based enterprise mobility services, roaming optimization, and logistics traceability solutions. Its portfolio included SmartCaller and the GlobalConnectTM platform for secure edge-to-cloud tracking and messaging.

MVNO & IoT Platform Innovator:
Powering supply-chain telemetry and enterprise mobility — private, compliant, and globally seamless.

Regulatory Foundation
Formally registered with the Swedish Post and Telecom Authority (PTS), Innotel AB operated as a fully licensed, regulated telecom provider — building trust through compliance, not publicity.

SmartCallerTM Enterprise Platform
Cut international and roaming voice costs by 40–95% — without changing user behavior.

An Android-native enterprise mobility solution, SmartCaller intelligently routes outbound calls through Innotel’s private MVNO stack. Savings happen in the background. Quality stays front and center.

Core Capabilities
International Call Optimization
Outbound international calls are transparently rerouted via Innotel’s low-cost network paths. No app switching. No dial-around. Just 40–95% less spend.

Roaming Optimization
Converts expensive outgoing roaming calls into lower-cost incoming calls — delivering average savings of 50% using preferential inbound roaming rates.

One Number CLI Solution
Choose what appears on the recipient’s phone:
mobile • office extension • PBX mainline • international number • or withheld.
Powered by Innotel’s global International Numbers portfolio.

Enterprise Ready
SmartCaller gives multinational enterprises full control over global voice costs — while preserving number portability, jurisdictional compliance, and seamless UX.
